name: Deepfathom Echo — "Then you may have it become a copy" at No: not a copy even with a creature picked
notes: Memory: project_may_action_behind_toggle_2026-10-11. "This creature explores. Then you may have it become a copy of another creature you control until end of turn." The copy is behind a toggle of its own; copy effects now take their line's toggle condition, so at No the Echo stays itself although a creature to copy has been picked.
